problem.observed: Required PR validation duplicated Netlify build parity while Supabase Preview Applicability consumed a global required runner on every PR.
problem.impact: Repeated exact-head builds and provider polling increased Actions fan-out, branch churn exposure and agent completion latency.

prevention.netlify: Own deterministic build parity once in the canonical website release lane; do not duplicate it in Required preflight.
prevention.supabase: Route database-relevant provider preview verification through the canonical Required test aggregate and skip it for non-database changes.
prevention.invariant: Keep branch protection fail-closed through the single canonical test context; do not remove provider proof before it is represented inside Required test.
